native_compiler: GCC16.2.1, -std=c++17 -O3 -DNDEBUG; two SAL annotation macros defined empty
shader_compiler: official DXC v1.9.2609, -T cs_6_0 -E main; runtime pipeline driver compilation separately measured
phase_boundary: init includes file loading, CPU reference/CSR prep, D3D12 object creation and upload-heap fill; retained GPU full excludes CPU controls and includes clear/record/dispatch/fence/readback/validation
cache_state: driver caches warmed by previous capability/smoke attempts; fresh native processes, no machine-cold claim
measurement_lock: per fresh-process case, released between cases
memory_scope: largest application CPU+GPU buffer payload; runtime/driver allocations unmeasured; Python generator array released before dispatch loops
concurrency_note: A bounded DXCore capability enumeration ran during the final matrix; ordinary host noise is not excluded. Five-block medians, not isolated-machine confidence intervals.
pin_path_policy: Repository-relative implementation paths and logical prepared/input roles. Original process paths remain in ignored raw observations.
